worldboss.beyondsolo.verdict.title: Ruler of the Verdict
worldboss.beyondsolo.verdict.domain.hint: Pillars of light fall on his foes here; those he does not judge are sheltered
worldboss.beyondsolo.verdict.authority.h: Stand between the arms of the cross, then step onto where they fell
worldboss.beyondsolo.wings.title: Ruler of a Thousand Wings
worldboss.beyondsolo.wings.domain.hint: Feathers of light fall on her foes here; keep moving
worldboss.beyondsolo.wings.authority.hin: Watch for the bands of wings, and run when she dives
worldboss.beyondsolo.hand.title: Ruler of the Unseen Hand
worldboss.beyondsolo.hand.domain.hint: The air itself seizes his foes here and lifts them
worldboss.beyondsolo.hand.authority.hint: The rings fall from the middle out: follow them in
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.bosses.ruler_v: A knight of white gold with a greatsword of light and wings of steel feathers. The rulers of light came to end the monarchs, and they judge whoever takes a crown as one of them. His last verdict is a cross of light cut through the land.
chronicle.beyondsolo.name.bosses.ruler_w: Caelistor, Ruler of a Thousand Wings
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.bosses.ruler_w: A lancer on four wings who fights from the sky. Her feathers fall like rain, and her dive runs a hunter through from a hundred paces. When she spreads every wing she has, the sky is cut into bands of light.
chronicle.beyondsolo.name.bosses.ruler_h: Ithrael, Ruler of the Unseen Hand
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.bosses.ruler_h: A masked figure in robes of white and gold whose great hands float at his side. He lifts hunters into the air and crushes them back into the ground. In his dominion the land falls in rings, from the middle out.
item.beyondsolo.mote_of_radiance.desc: A mote of a ruler's light. Use it for the Blessing of Light (%s min).
item.beyondsolo.mote_of_radiance.blessin: +%s%% damage to monarchs and their soldiers; a monarch's dread doesn't weigh on you
item.beyondsolo.mote_of_radiance.crowned: The light doesn't answer a crowned hunter.
ruler.beyondsolo.notify.descent: A rift of light is opening in the sky %2$s. %1$s comes down through it in %3$s s.
ruler.beyondsolo.notify.war.body: %1$s comes down %2$s in %3$s s to make war on %4$s. Fight at its side and the light will bless you. Strike it, and it will count you among its foes.
ruler.beyondsolo.notify.sentence.you: You wear a crown, and the light has judged you. %1$s comes down %2$s in %3$s s. Fell it to overturn the sentence, or die by it.
ruler.beyondsolo.notify.sentence.body: %1$s comes down %2$s in %3$s s to carry out its sentence on %4$s.
ruler.beyondsolo.notify.carried_out: %1$s has carried out its sentence: %2$s has fallen.
ruler.beyondsolo.notify.left: %s has gone back up through its rift.
ruler.beyondsolo.notify.stayed: The light stayed your blow. %s does not stand against you. Strike again and you stand against it.
ruler.beyondsolo.notify.turned: You stand against the light now. %s counts you among its foes.
ruler.beyondsolo.banner.descended: A ruler of light has descended
ruler.beyondsolo.banner.rift: A rift of light opens in the sky
ruler.beyondsolo.banner.war.hint: The light fights the monarch. Stand with it, or stand against both.
ruler.beyondsolo.banner.sentence.you.sub: %s comes for the crown you wear
ruler.beyondsolo.banner.sentence.sub: A ruler comes to judge a crowned hunter
ruler.beyondsolo.banner.blessed: Harder blows on monarchs and their soldiers for %s min
quest.beyondsolo.ruler.sentence.desc: %s has come to judge you for the crown you wear. Fell it and the sentence is overturned. If you die before it falls, the sentence is carried out.
quest.beyondsolo.ruler.war.desc: %1$s has come down to make war on %2$s. Help bring the monarch down while the ruler fights it, and the light will bless you.
title.beyondsolo.rulerbreaker.desc: Have a share in felling a ruler of light.
title.beyondsolo.eclipse.desc: Do the most to a ruler of light that falls.
title.beyondsolo.ally_of_the_dawn.desc: Help bring a monarch down at a ruler's side, and be blessed for it.
title.beyondsolo.unsentenced.desc: Fell the ruler of light that came to judge you.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.ruler.call: A ruler of light comes down 16 blocks ahead of you (random when left out). It came for no one: it fights whoever strikes it.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.ruler.war: A ruler comes down to make war on the monarch abroad.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.ruler.sente: A ruler comes down to judge the player (you when left out): they must fell it or die by it.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.ruler.land: The ruler coming down lands now.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.ruler.stop: The ruler abroad is gone at once, with its heralds.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.ruler.statu: What the ruler abroad is doing, and when the next Sentence of Light comes.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.ruler.next: The next Sentence of Light comes in that many minutes (for a crowned hunter).
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.ruler.bless: The Blessing of Light now (never on a crowned hunter).
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.ruler.recor: The player's record with the rulers of light.
command.beyondsolo.solo.ruler.war: %s is coming down to make war on %s.
command.beyondsolo.solo.ruler.next: The next Sentence of Light comes in %s min.
command.beyondsolo.solo.ruler.blessed: %s is blessed by the light for %s min.
command.beyondsolo.solo.ruler.record: %1$s · rulers felled %2$s (%3$s) · did the most %4$s · wars won at a ruler's side %5$s · sentences %6$s, overturned %7$s · heralds %8$s · blessings %9$s%10$s
command.beyondsolo.solo.ruler.status.non: No ruler abroad · next sentence %s · rulers felled %s
command.beyondsolo.solo.info.rulers: Rulers felled %s · sentences %s (overturned %s) · wars won at a ruler's side %s · heralds %s
command.beyondsolo.solo.error.no_ruler: No ruler of light is abroad (or it isn't coming down).
command.beyondsolo.solo.error.ruler_abro: A ruler of light is already abroad: /solo ruler stop first.
command.beyondsolo.solo.error.no_monarch: No monarch is abroad to make war on.
command.beyondsolo.solo.error.not_overwo: The rulers of light only come to the overworld.
command.beyondsolo.solo.error.unknown_ru: Unknown ruler: %s. Use verdict, wings, hand or random.
command.beyondsolo.solo.error.crowned_un: %s wears a crown: the light doesn't answer them.
